summary: Innate Pharma SA filed a Form 6-K reporting the voting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on May 21, 2026. All resolutions were voted with 94 votes cast out of 34,872,293 shares representing a quorum of 37.14%. The filing provides routine disclosure of shareholder meeting outcomes without any special-situation transaction. It includes standard background on the company's business, forward-looking disclaimers, and contact information. This is an ordinary current report of foreign private issuer results; no acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or other special situation is present.
